title: Porites lutea
author: QQman
modifications: Trimmed surrounding seabed, Removed the lowest 36% (stand or cut seabed), decimated 292,648 → 3,763 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Living colony scan; Indo-Pacific massive coral.

title: Madrepora humilis
author: The Smithsonian Institution
modifications: Removed the lowest 32% (stand or cut seabed), decimated 100,000 → 6,053 triangles, centred on base, textures removed (colour added procedurally), meshopt-compressed.
note: Digitate Acropora skeleton scan; tissue colour added in shader.

title: Pocillopora grandis
author: The Smithsonian Institution
modifications: decimated 100,000 → 8,088 triangles, centred on base, textures removed (colour added procedurally), meshopt-compressed.
note: Skeleton scan; tissue colour added in shader.

title: Tridacna (Flodacna) squamosa
author: The Smithsonian Institution
modifications: reoriented, decimated 99,994 → 4,704 triangles, centred on base, textures removed (colour added procedurally), meshopt-compressed.
note: Giant clam shell scan; mantle added in shader.

title: Sea turtle low poly
author: C.J..Goldman
modifications: decimated 16,218 → 16,218 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.

title: Акула рифова білопера
author: faerbogdan99
modifications: decimated 15,118 → 8,000 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Whitetip reef shark model. Also used, scaled to 3 m, to stand in for the oceanic whitetip (Carcharhinus longimanus), a larger carcharhinid with the same body plan.

title: Giant oceanic manta ray
author: faerbogdan99
modifications: decimated 40,000 → 8,000 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Model is titled 'giant oceanic manta' (M. birostris); the two species share a body plan and it stands in for the reef manta (M. alfredi) recorded at Guam.

title: Bottlenose_dolphin
author: teacherap123
modifications: decimated 21,750 → 8,000 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Model depicts a bottlenose dolphin; stretched lengthwise at load to approximate the slimmer spinner dolphin (Stenella longirostris) resident around Guam.

title: Animated Sperm Whale
author: Anees Animates
modifications: decimated 83,986 → 16,000 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 2048 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Animated sperm whale model; its rig's rest pose is baked in (level, head toward +z). Shown at the female length recorded around the Marianas (~12 m, NOAA).

title: Diver
author: ucdavisterc
modifications: Rig and animation kept, display plane removed, materials converted to metal-rough, textures resized to 2048 px WebP.
note: Rigged scuba diver (BCD, tank, regulator, fins) with its swim-cycle animation; the dive companion down to the scuba depth record.

title: CRRC (Combat-Rubber Raiding Craft)
author: blarg
modifications: decimated 68,686 → 39,997 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 2048 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Rigid-floored inflatable with an outboard, the kind dive crews launch from; the diver back-rolls off its side tube.

title: Shipwreck
author: bckface
modifications: removed the beach sand baked into the scan, dropped loose fragments, decimated 3,000,244 → 211,416 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Photogrammetry of an iron hull broken down to its ribs, captured on a beach; the baked sand is removed and the ribs are bedded into the wreck terrace at ~150 m. The finale's swim-through set.

title: Borgholm Castle
author: 333DDD
modifications: decimated 1,391,826 → 319,992 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 2048 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: Photogrammetry of the Borgholm Castle ruin (Öland, Sweden): a roofless fortress with round corner towers on its earthworks, scaled to ~58 m across the walls and sunk into the sand beyond the wreck as the finale's last set. Not a Guam site: artistic licence.

title: Treasure Chest
author: Multipainkiller Studio
modifications: Rig and animation kept, materials converted to metal-rough, textures resized to 1024 px WebP.
note: Iron-bound wooden chest with its lid-opening animation; what the diver came for waits inside.

title: Golden crown
author: Pieter Ferreira
modifications: decimated 8,316 → 8,316 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: A gold crown, resting in the chest in the castle's last room.

title: Poseidon's Trident
author: Astrocyclone71
modifications: decimated 3,384 → 3,384 triangles, centred on base, textures resized to 1024 px WebP, meshopt-compressed.
note: A gold trident (generic mythological sea-god's emblem), formed in the diver's hand as he becomes the king of the sea. Size is its widest horizontal extent (the prongs): the shaft is ~2.3 m.

title: Armored King
author: Calviking073
modifications: Rig and animation kept, materials converted to metal-rough, textures resized to 1024 px WebP.
note: A rigged, bearded king in gold armour with a crown-helm (an original fantasy character), recoloured in the shader to the sea's blues and greens: what the diver becomes at the end of the finale.
